contract: docs/WORK_SPEC.md S05: explicit download controls must locate the original element without automatically activating it; ordinary HTTP(S) navigation remains the user policy.

evidence.basis: The route names a file download operation and the same control contains an explicit download icon. Their combined original DOM evidence is sufficient for the explicit-download contract; not inferred event handlers.

decision.reason: Two concrete unresolved explicit-download identification counterexamples reopen S05. Earlier defined-case and live15 passes are bounded evidence and do not cover these controls.
decision.historicalRun004: Preserve previous 5/10 as the assessment before these counterexamples; do not rewrite historical evidence.

preservation.scope: No new source behavior, annotation, first metric, browser operation, network request or file download in this review.

nextWork.firstPriority: Conservative FileDown route plus explicit original download signal -> locate; retain normal lookalike navigation.
